products.title: Sí Quema Variety Pack
products.description:
Four tubs, one of each flavor — Mango, Watermelon, Kiwi Strawberry, Cucumber Lime. 5% off buying them one at a time, and the fastest way to find your flavor.
Serving: 1 scoop (4.5 g) · 30 servings per tub
200 mg caffeine · 2 g L-carnitine per serving
Nine ingredients, every dose on the label. No proprietary blends.
Per serving
Caffeine Anhydrous — 200 mg
N-Acetyl L-Carnitine HCl — 1 g
L-Carnitine L-Tartrate — 1 g
L-Tyrosine — 500 mg
L-Theanine — 350 mg
Capsimax® Cayenne Extract — 100 mg
Gamma-Butyrobetaine HCl — 75 mg
AstraGin® — 50 mg
Grains of Paradise Extract — 40 mg
30-day money-back guarantee. Free U.S. shipping; ships from California in 1–2 business days.
Warnings: Contains 200 mg of caffeine per serving. Do not exceed one serving (1 scoop) per day. Do not combine with other caffeine or stimulants. Not for use by anyone under 18. Do not use if pregnant or nursing. Consult a licensed healthcare professional before use, especially if you have high blood pressure, a heart, thyroid, liver or kidney condition, diabetes, anxiety or a seizure disorder, or if you take any medication. Discontinue use and consult a doctor if you experience any adverse reaction.
*These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
